popular_for: Factory twin-turbo GT-R engine, excellent high-rpm power, massive aftermarket

exhaust.approx_port_dimensions_mm: ~36–42 mm OD tube common; flange ports sized for ~36.5 mm ID / 42 mm OD pipe in many aftermarket flanges
exhaust.stud_thread: M8 x 1.25 (unique vs other RB engines which often use M10)
exhaust.stud_notes: RB26 specifically uses M8 studs. Titanium kits popular. Confirm length for aftermarket manifolds.
useful_checks: M8 thread (distinguishes from RB20/25 in some cases)
Port size suitable for 41–42 mm primary tubing

sources_notes: Titanium stud kits explicitly list M8x1.25 for RB26. Flange makers specify pipe sizes around 36.5/42 mm.
